id.description: Globally unique identifier for the list item (UUID).

list_id.description: The ID of the list that contains the item.

value.description:
The item's value, normalized (lowercased and trimmed) on write. The format depends on the parent list's `type`:
a domain, a top-level domain, or an email address.

created_at.description: When the item was added to the list, in seconds using the Unix timestamp format.
